decision_reason: No executable next scope can be authorized without inventing account-to-learner cardinality, role and profile-management authority, grade-change authority, consent and retention policy, REAL-record admission rules, or session transition policy. Session preparation is additionally blocked by the absence of an approved live runtime bundle and BE3 live-engine integration.

authorized_tables.mutation_authority: No new live or API mutation authority is granted by this record.

authorized_response_fields.note: The architecture's proposed roles and learner expansion for /api/v1/me is not authorized by this record.

resolved: A verified Supabase JWT subject is the external authenticated identity key.
The Supabase subject maps conceptually to app_users and must never be used as learner_id.
learner_id is an opaque pseudonymous UUID.
Possession of a learner or session UUID is never authorization.
Roles and relationships must be server-controlled and must not be trusted from editable client metadata.
unresolved: Whether an account owns one learner or multiple learners.
Who may create, list, retrieve, update, deactivate, relink, or unlink learner profiles.
Whether learner, guardian, parent, supervisor, teacher, operator, researcher, or administrator roles exist in the application and their exact capabilities.
How app_users rows are provisioned, activated, disabled, and reconciled with Supabase subjects.
Who assigns learner grade and who may change it.
ownership_rules.fail_closed: No learner resource may be selected or mutated from an authenticated subject until the relationship and role contract is approved.

blockers: Account-to-learner cardinality and access-control ownership are unresolved.
Profile provisioning and grade-change authority are unresolved.
Consent, retention, withdrawal, and deletion policies are unresolved.
REAL provenance admission is not authorized.

session_lifecycle_review.existing_database_rule: At most one starting or active session per learner.
blockers: Session transition ownership, replacement, recovery, expiry, and completion policies are unresolved.
Learner ownership and access control are unresolved.
No approved published live runtime bundle exists.
BE3 live-engine integration is not authorized.

session_preparation.classification: Session preparation is a BE2 lifecycle operation with BE3 bundle and engine prerequisites; it is not authorized by architecture prose alone and must not silently become BE4 learning behavior.
session_preparation.fail_closed: Do not create a starting or active real session, pin a bundle, or return a prepared-session DTO.

future_contract: Every state-changing command requires an opaque Idempotency-Key.
Scope by verified actor, HTTP method, operation identifier, and key.
Store a canonical request fingerprint and canonical committed response atomically with the domain mutation.
Identical replay returns the committed response; body mismatch fails with a stable conflict.
Concurrent replay must not execute the mutation twice.

future_real_requirements: source_class must be REAL and server-assigned, never accepted from the client.
actor_user_id must be derived from the verified subject-to-app_users mapping.
request_id, operation_or_event_type, reason_code, resource type and ID, source system, environment, schema revision, and server timestamp are mandatory.
TEST, SYNTHETIC, and IMPORTED records must be rejected by live command paths.
Tests must use isolated databases and visibly non-real identities.

future_minimum: Audit profile creation, grade changes, status changes, relationship changes, session lifecycle commands, bundle selection, overrides, and privileged reads.
Record verified actor, request ID, reason, target resource, before and after references or versions, timestamp, environment, and approval evidence when required.
Audit records are append-only and contain no token, Authorization header, raw answer, answer key, or direct personal identifier.

privacy_constraints: Store only an opaque learner identifier, governed grade, and neutral status when later authorized.
Do not store names, contact details, date of birth, diagnosis, population, subtype, hidden learner truth, or research-group membership in the operational learner profile.
Separate authentication identity from learner and research identifiers.
Do not expose raw JWT claims, tokens, private task data, scientific parameters, or research identifiers.
No research export or identity join is authorized.
Retention, withdrawal, deletion, consent, and child-safety policies must be approved before REAL records are admitted.
prohibited_behavior: REAL learner or session record creation

unresolved_blockers.name: account_to_learner_cardinality_and_ownership
unresolved_blockers.required_decision: Approve exact cardinality, provisioning source, relationship types, and resource permissions.

unresolved_blockers.name: role_vocabulary_and_authority
unresolved_blockers.required_decision: Reconcile learner/supervisor/operator with learner/guardian/teacher/researcher/admin and approve exact server-controlled capabilities.

unresolved_blockers.name: learner_profile_and_grade_governance
unresolved_blockers.required_decision: Approve who creates, reads, updates, deactivates, and changes grade, including permitted fields.

unresolved_blockers.name: real_data_consent_retention_withdrawal_and_deletion
unresolved_blockers.required_decision: Approve REAL-data admission, consent evidence, retention periods, withdrawal, deletion or anonymization, and environment isolation.

unresolved_blockers.name: session_lifecycle_and_preparation
unresolved_blockers.required_decision: Approve the smallest executable transition set, ownership checks, response contract, idempotency, expiry and recovery semantics.

unresolved_blockers.name: live_runtime_bundle_and_engine_prerequisites
unresolved_blockers.required_decision: Approve a complete published runtime bundle and separately authorize BE3 live-engine integration before question issuance.

fail_closed_behavior: Keep all new endpoint and lifecycle authorization lists empty.
Do not infer learner ownership from a Supabase subject, email, UUID, or editable token metadata.
Do not create app_users, learner, relationship, or session rows through live requests.
Do not assign a default grade, role, relationship, consent state, expiry, or runtime bundle.
Do not expose learner profile or session data beyond the existing approved /api/v1/me principal fields.
Keep pilot and production readiness false.
required_tests_for_future_authorized_sco: Subject-to-app_users provisioning, uniqueness, disabled-account, and fail-closed mapping tests.
Role and relationship authorization matrix tests, including cross-learner IDOR denial.
Learner profile field allow-list, PII rejection, grade authority, and deactivation tests.
REAL provenance server-assignment and TEST/SYNTHETIC/IMPORTED live-path rejection tests.
Idempotent identical replay, mismatched body, concurrent replay, and atomic rollback tests.
Audit completeness, append-only behavior, privileged-read audit, and sensitive-log leakage tests.
Consent, withdrawal, retention, deletion or anonymization, and environment-isolation tests.
If session preparation is later authorized: ownership, one-active-session, eligible-bundle pin, transition matrix, recovery, and no-question/no-engine boundary tests.
exit_criteria: Every unresolved blocker needed by the selected next scope has a named owner, explicit approved decision, and authoritative source.
A replacement or amendment machine-readable authorization enumerates exact endpoints, fields, roles, ownership rules, transitions, provenance, audit, idempotency, and privacy behavior.
REAL data remains prohibited unless consent, retention, withdrawal, deletion, and environment-isolation rules are explicitly approved.
Session preparation remains prohibited unless its transition and response contract and an eligible approved runtime-bundle path are explicitly authorized.
No scientific or live-engine behavior is included unless separately authorized for BE3 or later.
next_governance_task: Obtain owner decisions for account-to-learner cardinality, reconciled role vocabulary, learner profile and grade authority, and REAL-data privacy governance; then issue a narrower machine-readable authorization before implementation.
